directive: Creator: find another pattern - look through the museum exhibits, all the H arcs
method: searched the H arcs and the H9 B-side imagineering deck; selection criterion was the one the last two designs taught - GAP (ideal minus floor) is the noise budget, so hunt the largest gap rather than the strongest floor
found: H7 P2, THE CLOAKING DEVICE (exp248, ibm_fez, FLOWN) - a logical bit in [[4,2,2]] is invisible to any single-qubit probe while remaining readable logically
COMPARATOR_INTERROGATION_the_decisive_ca: the 0.41 gap is REAL and MEASURED but it is a gap over a WEAKER COMPARATOR CLASS. The floor bounds an agent with ONE of four qubits; the same flight measured that a TWO-qubit probe recovers 0.87-1.0 bits, so a CLASSICAL agent holding two qubits reads the stimulus by local measurement and parity. Type A bounds ANY classical-memory agent at a copy budget (resource bound, access unrestricted); Type B bounds ANY non-contextual assignment (structural, access-free); Type C bounds a 1-of-4 ACCESS level and collapses if the comparator gets a second qubit.
WHAT_IT_ACTUALLY_IS: NOT a bigger advantage - a DIFFERENT PROPERTY. A reflex arc whose STIMULUS IS PRIVATE: the neuron responds to something a bounded observer cannot read, certified as an eavesdropper-vs-owner asymmetry Holevo-bounded over ALL measurements at 1-qubit access. No Type A or B neuron has that capability. Worth having on its own terms, not dressed as a larger separation.

engineering_notes.post_selection: [[4,2,2]] is error-DETECTING and the flown fidelities are post-selected at 0.904-0.966 acceptance. A NEURON CANNOT POST-SELECT - it must answer every trial - so the honest number guesses on rejected shots: 0.9261. A three-outcome neuron (0/1/ABSTAIN) is the alternative and needs the comparator to be allowed to abstain too, which is a court question.
engineering_notes.readout: logical read is a 2-qubit parity, so the read burden is LOW - relevant since we are measured readout-limited

verdict: a genuine THIRD neuron type with a measured, large gap and a narrower comparator. Recommended as a PRIVACY organ rather than as a replacement claim. Not proposed for flight tonight.
